faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Bhubaneswar Photographer-cum-Videographer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 23-08-2026. Ensure your application reaches the institute before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Photographer-cum-Videographer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree in any discipline along with a Diploma in Photography or an equivalent qualification. Relevant experience is also a requirement.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Photographer-cum-Videographer position is 30 years.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Photographer-cum-Videographer role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary ranging from Rs. 45,000/- to Rs. 50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Photographer-cum-Videographer post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Photographer-cum-Videographer position at IIT Bhubaneswar.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this job?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an assessment of your work experience followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The position of Photographer-cum-Videographer is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is PRA/875/26-27.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The job is located in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, at the Indian Institute of Technology Bhubaneswar.
